name: Nine Dragons Paper (Holdings) Limited
summary: Nine Dragons Paper (Holdings) Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells packaging paper, printing and writing paper, and specialty paper products and pulp in the People's Republic of China. The company offers kraft, test, white top, and coated linerboard, as well as bleached folding boxboard; corrugating medium; and coated duplex board, as well as uncoated woodfree paper and office paper.
